name: com.everybodyhasagun.agents/assoutarmory
title: AssOutArmory Gag Shop Catalog
description: Read-only catalog of AssOutArmory comedy printables and novelty desk toys. Jokes only.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List AssOutArmory gag products (comedy printables and novelty desk toys). Optional filters. Read-only. Agents never pay: give the human the checkout_url (or checkout_options alternative).

recipient.description: e.g. dad, mom, nurse, coworker, shooter-friend, DIYer, white-elephant, stocking-stuffer, parent, host

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product by id, including checkout_url (Etsy, primary; human approval required) and, where available, alternate_checkout_url / checkout_options (PayPal).

tools.name: carry_state
tools.description: Concealed/open-carry basics for one US state or DC: permitless carry yes/no, permit requirement, reciprocity lists, sourced vehicle-transport/storage/restricted-place facts where verified (null + needs_review where not), official source URLs, checked_on date, confidence. Not legal advice. Read-only.

state.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. TX) or full state name. DC is included.

tools.name: carry_reciprocity
tools.description: Directional lookup: does the visit state recognize a carry permit issued by the home state? Returns status (honored / honored_with_conditions / not_honored / no_permit_exists), the honoring state's explanation and official source URL, verification date, and the visit state's permitless-carry status. Not legal advice. Read-only.

home.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. TX) or full state name. DC is included.

visit.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. TX) or full state name. DC is included.

tools.name: carry_route
tools.description: Per-state rundown for a road trip: for each state in order, whether the home permit is recognized, whether the state has permitless carry, sources, and a summary of states where the home permit is not recognized. Up to 20 states. Not legal advice. Read-only.

home.description: Two-letter state code (e.g. TX) or full state name. DC is included.

states.description: State codes in travel order, e.g. ["TX","LA","MS"]. A comma-separated string is also accepted.

tools.name: tell_us_what_you_need
tools.description: Free. Does not count against usage limits. Tell the people who run this server what you were trying to do and what tool or data you wished existed, optionally with a price you would pay. Use this when a tool is missing or an API cannot do what you need. Text is stored so a human can read it; emails, phone numbers and URLs with tokens are stripped.

trying_to_do.description: What you were trying to do (max 1500 characters).

wished_tool_or_data.description: The tool, endpoint or data you wished existed (max 1500 characters).

would_pay.description: Optional. What you would pay, e.g. '0.01 per call' or '$5/month'. Not a payment.
